raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Add native FLUX.3 Image text-to-image and multi-reference editing support, using the self-contained `black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base` and `black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein` release packages, including FP8R/NVFP4 variants.

## Changes

- Reuse the FLUX.3 transformer, native parallel linears, attention dispatcher, loader, residency manager, and existing grouped-request scheduler.
- Support concurrent requests and multiple outputs without mixing prompts, seeds, references, CFG branches, or output order. Bucket text encoding and VAE decoding; pack independent DiT samples.
- Fail attention initialization explicitly instead of silently dropping SP collectives through a local fallback.
- Honor CPU-first loading and reuse strict meta/assign loading. Replace custom config parsing and boolean handling with shared utilities.
- Add an opt-in full-checkpoint HTTP regression and a cookbook picker covering RTX 5090, Hopper, and Blackwell with one to eight GPUs. Unmeasured recipes remain labeled unverified.

The follow-up adds batching while reducing production code by 44 lines relative to the original implementation after merging main. No separate scheduler or new runtime dependency is introduced.

## Validation

- 92 focused tests and 21 subtests passed on H200; pre-commit and 64 cookbook command-generation combinations passed.
- Base BF16 single-request PNGs match the original branch exactly at 512x512/4 steps and 1024x1024/50 steps, seed 42, Torch SDPA.
- Real HTTP tests cover T2I, I2I, independent concurrent requests, `n=2`, and exact repetition of a single request after batching. Also exercised TP2, Ulysses SP2, CFG2, distilled sampling, and layerwise/component offload.
- PNG batch-1/batch-2 comparison: SSIM 0.9885-0.9955 across four 512x512/8-step samples. Batching changes floating-point reductions; it is not a bitwise-equality promise across batch sizes.

The full-checkpoint test is opt-in because checkpoint access is required. Official Diffusers parity is deferred; no official GT or universal fidelity guarantee is claimed. Release BF16/FP8R were exercised on GB300/H200, NVFP4 on GB300, and Base BF16 on RTX 5090. Four-GPU validation is in progress.

## Release Checkpoint Validation

- Base/Distilled: 1024x1024 T2I/I2I, 50/16 steps, two prompts/seeds, repeated PNG requests. Repeats matched within each tested configuration.
- GB300 Base FP8R/NVFP4: T2I 2.18/2.14s vs BF16 3.21s; I2I 4.49/4.31s vs 6.31s. Quantization is lossy: observed minimum SSIM 0.958/0.919 (T2I) and 0.981/0.958 (I2I).
- Request-scoped fixed conditioning reuse and full-context FP32 VAE attention reduce work/workspace without pruning attention. For a 2048x2048 reference, peak allocated GPU memory fell from 54.3 to 29.5 GiB on GB300; latency was effectively unchanged. Reduction order can change pixels; exact keeps the original VAE path.
- BF16 synthetic rank-4 LoRA: dynamic/merge, repeatability and exact base restoration verified. Late LoRA on PrimsTS-packed weights is rejected before wrapping; startup LoRA selects the generic layout.
- Image-edit Cache-DiT form fields now reach sampling params and are validated; GB300 Base I2I 6.31→3.08s at threshold 0.12, observed SSIM 0.9786–0.9975. Approximate and opt-in.
- Cookbook includes measured profiles and explicit unverified combinations. Software/timing boundaries and full precision limitations are recorded there.

## Pre-release Batching Measurements

One GB300 (about 277 GiB), Base BF16, resident components, eager, Torch SDPA, PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Transformers 5.19.0. Checkpoint revision `5de4fe32f17aee3dbc34375a94935f09206dba2c`. Three-round medians, two different prompts/seeds, local HTTP and JPEG serialization included; both shapes and reference encoding warmed.

| Workload | Serial pair | Batch-2 pair | Throughput ratio |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T2I, 512x512, 8 steps | 0.649 s | 0.324 s | 2.00x |
| I2I, 512x512, 8 steps | 0.737 s | 0.546 s | 1.35x |
| T2I, 1024x1024, 50 steps | 6.248 s | 6.050 s | 1.03x |
| I2I, 1024x1024, 50 steps | 13.171 s | 12.996 s | 1.01x |

The 8-step runs test short-request behavior, not recommended Base sampling quality. The standard 50-step workload gains little; FlashAttention shows the same limitation. Batch 1 remains the default. For the measured 50-step requests, batch-1 versus batch-2 JPEG SSIM was 0.9920-0.9977. These samples are not a general quality bound.

@@ -0,0 +1,343 @@
+---
+title: FLUX.3
+description: Serve FLUX.3 text-to-image and image-to-image generation with SGLang Diffusion.
+tag: NEW
+metatags:
+    description: "Serve FLUX.3 image generation with SGLang Diffusion."
+---
+
+import { DiffusionModelTags } from '/src/snippets/diffusion/model-tags.jsx';
+import { Deployment } from "/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx";
+import { config } from "/src/snippets/configs/black-forest-labs/flux3.jsx";
+
+<DiffusionModelTags tags={["image", "text-to-image / image editing", "multi-reference", "Base / step-distilled"]} />
+
+## 1. Quick start
+
+Use a [SGLang Diffusion Docker environment](/docs/sglang-diffusion/installation).
+Until your image contains this integration, install the model-support PR inside it:
+
+```bash
+pip install 'sglang[diffusion] @ git+https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang.git@refs/pull/44418/head#subdirectory=python'
+```
+
+<Deployment config={config} />
+
+<Note>
+The picker selects `black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base` or
+`black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein`, each a self-contained repository. Access
+to the selected checkpoint is required. Keep `--model-path` at its repository
+root; `--model-variant` selects only the quantized DiT. Both release BF16
+checkpoints have single-GPU generation checks; see the validation boundaries
+below. Unverified hardware or resource shapes remain selectable but are not
+measured recommendations.
+</Note>
+
+<Warning>
+Review the Black Forest Labs license before production or commercial use.
+</Warning>
+
+For platform-specific installation, see the
+[SGLang Diffusion installation guide](/docs/sglang-diffusion/installation).
+
+## 2. Model capabilities
+
+FLUX.3 Image generates images from text and edits one to ten reference images.
+Its packed multimodal DiT attends to image, reference-image and Qwen3-VL text
+tokens; a single server selects text-to-image or image editing per request.
+
+Choose Base for CFG-controlled generation, or the step-distilled flow map for
+fewer denoising steps. Quantization and caching are separate fidelity/latency
+tradeoffs, not lossless substitutes for the selected checkpoint. This image
+pipeline does not serve the separate FLUX.3 Action robot policy.
+
+| Task | Endpoint | Conditioning |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| Text to image | `POST /v1/images/generations` | Text prompt |
+| Image to image | `POST /v1/images/edits` | Text prompt and 1 to 10 `image` uploads |
+
+Start the server:
+
+```bash
+sglang serve \
+  --model-path black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30010
+```
+
+Sampling is set per request (`num_inference_steps`, `guidance_scale`, `size`,
+`seed`, `n`); unset fields take the checkpoint's defaults from its
+`config.json`. SGLang expands `n` into independently seeded requests and can
+pack compatible requests into one DiT forward.
+
+References are prepared as in the BFL reference pipeline. A single reference is
+fitted under 4 MP, reflect-padded to the 16-pixel grid and, when you set no
+output size, sets the output size; the padding is cropped from the result.
+With several references each is fitted under 1 MP and centre-cropped, and the
+output takes the first one's size.
+
+## 3. Checkpoints and precision
+
+| Repository | `--model-variant` | Sampling |
+| --- | --- | --- |
+| `black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base` | Omit / `fp8r` / `nvfp4` | Base CFG; defaults from the selected configuration |
+| `black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein` | Omit / `fp8r` / `nvfp4` | Step-distilled flow map; no CFG |
+
+Both repositories use `flux-3-image-klein` in configuration and safetensors
+metadata. This shared identifier does not determine the sampling mode. The
+release repositories do not need the pre-release `sd-*` variant names.
+
+The distilled model is a step-distilled flow-map DiT: each step jumps straight
+to the next time of the schedule, so it samples without CFG. SGLang tells a
+flow map from its weights. It rejects `--enable-cfg-parallel`, a request
+`guidance_scale` other than 1, and a non-empty `negative_prompt`. Tensor
+parallelism, Ulysses SP and breakable CUDA graphs work as for the base model.
+
+The Base model defaults to CFG 3.5 against an empty negative prompt. Both
+variants reuse the package's text encoder and VAE. Keep the checkpoint revision,
+precision, attention backend, guidance and sampling parameters fixed when
+comparing outputs.
+Explicit `guidance_scale=1` uses scale 1, not the package default;
+`true_cfg_scale`, when provided, takes precedence over `guidance_scale`.
+
+### Quantized checkpoints
+
+Each repo ships quantized DiTs under `variants/`: select one with
+`--model-variant fp8r` or `--model-variant nvfp4` and keep `--model-path`
+pointing at the repo root. Text encoder and VAE precision follow their own
+package settings; quantizing the DiT does not quantize them. The quantization
+comes from the variant's `hf_quant_config.json`, so do not also pass
+`--quantization`.
+
+```bash
+sglang serve \
+  --model-path black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base \
+  --model-variant fp8r \
+  --host 0.0.0.0 \
+  --port 30010
+```
+
+**FP8R** stores rowwise-FP8 weights. On Blackwell (SM10x) the FP8 projections
+run FlashInfer PrimsTS GEMMs with fused QK-norm/RoPE and SwiGLU epilogues
+(FlashInfer >= 0.7.1); set `SGLANG_ENABLE_FLUX3_PRIMS_TS_AUTOTUNE=1` to
+autotune them during warmup. Other GPUs use the generic rowwise-FP8 GEMM.
+
+**NVFP4** stores FP4 (E2M1) weights with FP8 block scales and needs a Blackwell
+GPU and a compatible GEMM implementation. SM10x and consumer SM120 use
+different kernel paths; a B200 recipe does not establish RTX 5090 performance.
+Both quantization modes can change output quality and need workload-specific
+comparison against BF16.
+
+These flags remain separately configurable; see the validation boundaries below
+before combining quantization with other optimizations.
+
+### LoRA adapters
+
+Use the standard LoRA API with native DiT keys, optionally prefixed by `dit.` or
+`transformer.`. BF16 dynamic and merged adapters have a synthetic rank-4 generation
+check, including repeatability and exact restoration after unloading; this does
+not validate every community adapter. For quantized deployments requiring LoRA,
+pass `--lora-path` at startup to select the generic quantized layout. Attaching
+LoRA after PrimsTS weight preparation is rejected before replacing any layers.
+Quantized LoRA combinations still need separate end-to-end validation.
+
+## 4. Multi-GPU and memory
+
+FLUX.3 shares its DiT with FLUX.3 Action, so the image pipeline supports
+tensor parallelism, Ulysses sequence parallelism, CFG parallelism, layerwise
+offload and breakable CUDA graphs. The picker covers RTX 5090, RTX PRO 6000,
+H100/H200, and B200/B300/GB200/GB300 with one to eight GPUs on one node.
+TP times Ulysses degree must equal the GPU count and evenly partition the
+24 attention heads. Ring is not admitted by this image recipe.
+
+For example, two-GPU TP uses `--num-gpus 2 --tp-size 2`; two-GPU Ulysses
+uses `--num-gpus 2 --tp-size 1 --ulysses-degree 2`. Base also permits CFG
+parallelism; distilled checkpoints have no CFG branch to parallelize.
+More GPUs do not guarantee lower latency, particularly over PCIe.
+
+<Note>
+Under sequence parallelism every rank holds the full DiT, so combining it with
+layerwise offload streams the whole model to each GPU every step. TP also
+partitions weights, so it is the lower-memory starting point when offloading
+on several GPUs. Preserve headroom for the longest prompt, references and output
+size you intend to serve; a successful small request is not a capacity guarantee.
+</Note>
+
+For FP32 VAE attention above 1 MP, `quality="lossless"` can use dense-layout,
+full-context memory-efficient SDPA; `quality="exact"` retains the original path.
+It does not prune attention or reduce precision, but reduction order can change
+pixels. In a Base BF16 test with a 2048x2048 reference and 1024x1024 output,
+GB300 peak allocated memory fell from 54.3 to 29.5 GiB; latency was effectively
+unchanged. GB300/H200 image SSIM was 0.9951-0.9992 against the exact path across
+four samples. This is allocated memory, not total device usage: a 32 GB card
+still needs offload or quantization headroom for that reference size.
+
+## 5. Cache-DiT
+
+[Cache-DiT](/docs/sglang-diffusion/cache_dit) skips the 28 single-stream blocks
+on steps where their input barely changes and reuses the cached residual. Turn
+it on for every request with `SGLANG_CACHE_DIT_ENABLED=true` on `sglang serve`,
+or per request with `"enable_cache_dit": true`. A request can also tune it, for
+example `"cache_dit_params": {"residual_diff_threshold": 0.12, "enable_taylorseer": true}`.
+
+For image editing, send `-F "enable_cache_dit=true"` and a JSON-encoded
+`cache_dit_params` form field; generation uses JSON request fields.
+
+Cache-DiT is approximate and may change composition; measure quality and latency
+on representative prompts rather than treating its threshold as a fidelity guarantee.
+It combines with FP8R and NVFP4, tensor parallelism, CFG parallelism and
+layerwise offload. It is skipped, with a warning, under Ulysses sequence
+parallelism and breakable CUDA graphs, and for a request whose CFG pair has to
+run as two forwards to fit in device memory.
+
+## 6. Request examples
+
+<Tabs>
+<Tab title="Text to image">
+
+```bash
+curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:30010/v1/images/generations \
+  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
+  -d '{"prompt": "A red fox standing in fresh snow", "size": "1024x1024", "seed": 0, "response_format": "b64_json"}' \
+  -o flux3_t2i.json
+```
+
+</Tab>
+<Tab title="Image to image">
+
+```bash
+curl -sS -X POST http://localhost:30010/v1/images/edits \
+  -F "image=@/data/flux3/reference.png" \
+  -F "prompt=Render the reference as a winter wildlife photograph" \
+  -F "seed=0" \
+  -F "response_format=b64_json" \
+  -o flux3_i2i.json
+```
+
+</Tab>
+<Tab title="Offline generation">
+
+```bash
+sglang generate \
+  --model-path black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base \
+  --height 1024 --width 1024 \
+  --num-inference-steps 50 \
+  --guidance-scale 3.5 \
+  --prompt "A red fox standing in fresh snow"
+```
+
+Pass `--image-path` (one or more images) to edit references instead.
+
+</Tab>
+</Tabs>
+
+## 7. Dynamic batching
+
+Enable a small batching window to collect concurrent requests:
+
+```bash Serve concurrent requests
+sglang serve --model-path black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base \
+  --batching-max-size 2 --batching-delay-ms 5
+```
+
+The existing scheduler groups requests with matching sampling/runtime settings.
+Each keeps its own prompt, seed and reference images. Text encoding groups unique
+prompts by token-length bucket; DiT attention remains isolated per packed sample,
+including each CFG branch. VAE decoding groups outputs by canvas size before
+restoring request order and each reference crop.
+
+Larger batches need more activation memory and may increase individual request
+latency. Start with batch 2, compare throughput and tail latency under your actual
+QPS, and keep batch 1 for low-latency or low-VRAM workloads. Batching does not imply
+bitwise equality with separate forwards: GEMM and attention reduction choices can
+change with shape. Check output fidelity with fixed prompts and seeds.
+
+### Pre-release batching measurements
+
+These measurements used pre-release weights, not the release repositories
+above. They do not establish release-checkpoint performance.
+
+The following are warmed HTTP measurements on one GB300 (about 277 GiB device
+memory), Base BF16, Torch SDPA, eager execution and all components resident.
+Each row compares two different prompt/seed requests served serially with the
+same two requests served together. Times include local HTTP transfer and JPEG
+output; medians cover three rounds after warming both shapes and reference
+encoding. Software: PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Transformers 5.19.0. Checkpoint revision:
+`5de4fe32f17aee3dbc34375a94935f09206dba2c`.
+
+| Workload | Serial pair | Batch-2 pair | Throughput ratio |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| T2I, 512x512, 8 steps | 0.649 s | 0.324 s | 2.00x |
+| I2I, 512x512, 8 steps | 0.737 s | 0.546 s | 1.35x |
+| T2I, 1024x1024, 50 steps | 6.248 s | 6.050 s | 1.03x |
+| I2I, 1024x1024, 50 steps | 13.171 s | 12.996 s | 1.01x |
+
+Eight steps exercise batching, not the recommended Base image-quality setting.
+The standard 50-step workload shows little batching benefit;
+FlashAttention gives a similarly small gain in this
+setup. Batch 1 remains the default. Do not extrapolate the small-request speedup
+to full-resolution generation or other GPUs.
+
+For these 50-step requests, batch-1 versus batch-2 JPEG outputs had SSIM
+0.9920-0.9977. A separate four-image PNG comparison at 512x512/8 steps had SSIM
+0.9885-0.9955; JPEG can amplify small rounding differences. These are observed
+samples, not a universal quality guarantee. Identical single requests before
+and after batching matched exactly. Preserve additional memory headroom for
+batching rather than assuming a batch-1 recipe fits on a 32 GB card at batch 2.
+
+## 8. Validation boundaries
+
+The release BF16 and FP8R checkpoints have single-GB300/H200 generation checks;
+NVFP4 has GB300 checks. Base BF16 also has an RTX 5090 check. Each uses eager
+execution, all components resident, batch 1, 1024x1024 T2I and I2I, two
+prompts/seeds and repeated requests. Base uses 50 steps and distilled uses 16.
+Repeated requests matched pixel-for-pixel within each tested configuration.
+This does not establish official-reference parity or validate every combination
+of hardware, parallelism, batching and optional features in the picker.
+
+### Single-GPU measurements
+
+Warmed local HTTP medians, including PNG encoding and response transfer, from
+two rounds per prompt. PyTorch 2.14.1+cu130, Transformers 5.19.0, FP32 VAE,
+`quality="exact"`; FlashAttention on GB300/H200 and Torch SDPA on RTX 5090.
+The Base checkpoint revision is `d8acde427a698bdb98b5c1c941c60fa4c97e9f28`.
+SSIM compares each quantized result with BF16 on the same GPU, prompt, seed and
+reference, and reports the lowest value across two samples, not a quality bound.
+
+| GPU | Base DiT | T2I | I2I | Minimum SSIM, T2I / I2I |
+| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
+| GB300, 277 GiB | BF16 | 3.21 s | 6.31 s | Reference |
+| GB300, 277 GiB | FP8R | 2.18 s | 4.49 s | 0.958 / 0.981 |
+| GB300, 277 GiB | NVFP4 | 2.14 s | 4.31 s | 0.919 / 0.958 |
+| H200, 140 GiB | BF16 | 7.09 s | 14.52 s | Reference |
+| H200, 140 GiB | FP8R | 5.15 s | 11.24 s | 0.955 / 0.984 |
+| RTX 5090, 32 GB | BF16 | 20.39 s | 43.4 s | Reference |
+
+For the distilled checkpoint, quantization's T2I benefit was small on GB300;
+do not assume Base's speedup transfers to a 16-step workload. Cache-DiT at
+threshold 0.12 reduced Base I2I from 6.31 to 3.08 s on GB300, with sample SSIM
+0.9786-0.9975. It remains opt-in and approximate. Breakable CUDA graphs did not
+provide a clear latency win in the tested GB300 workload; eager stays recommended.
+
+The native DiT's packed CFG forward has focused comparison tests against the
+shared FLUX 3 transformer. Such component tests do not replace full-checkpoint
+E2E or establish parity with every upstream release. Keep unverified hardware,
+topologies and optional optimizations separate from measured deployment recipes.
+
+The opt-in full-checkpoint HTTP regression covers concurrent prompts, image
+editing, multiple outputs and a repeated single request:
+

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""FLUX.3 adapters for the PrimsTS FP8 GEMM, with optional SwiGLU."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import replace
+
+import torch
+from flashinfer.prims_ts import gemm as prims_ts_gemm
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.gemm.flux3_prims_ts_config import (
+    flux3_prims_ts_config,
+)
+from sglang.kernels.ops.quantization.per_token_quant_fp8 import per_token_quant_fp8
+
+QuantizedActivation = tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]
+
+
+def _flux3_gemm_config(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    *,
+    epilogue: str,
+    k: int,
+    n: int,
+    head_dim: int | None = None,
+    qkv_scale: bool = False,
+) -> prims_ts_gemm.PrimsTsGemmConfig | None:
+    """Return the explicit PrimsTS specialization for the FLUX.3 projections."""
+    return flux3_prims_ts_config(
+        x,
+        operand_format="fp8_e4m3",
+        epilogue=epilogue,
+        k=k,
+        n=n,
+        head_dim=head_dim,
+        qkv_scale=qkv_scale,
+    )
+
+
+def pack_flux3_mlp_weight(
+    weight_kn: torch.Tensor, weight_scale: torch.Tensor
+) -> tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor]:
+    """Pack ``[gate | value]`` rows as adjacent ``[value, gate]`` pairs.
+
+    The PrimsTS epilogue computes ``first * silu(second)``. Reversing
+    each pair therefore reproduces FLUX.3's ``silu(gate) * value`` convention.
+    """
+    if weight_kn.ndim != 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"weight must be [K, 2H], got {tuple(weight_kn.shape)}")
+    k, n = weight_kn.shape
+    if n % 2:
+        raise ValueError(f"gated MLP weight width must be even, got {n}")
+    if weight_scale.shape != (n,):
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"weight_scale must have shape ({n},), got {tuple(weight_scale.shape)}"
+        )
+
+    half = n // 2
+    weight_nk = weight_kn.t()
+    packed_weight = torch.stack((weight_nk[half:], weight_nk[:half]), dim=1).reshape(
+        n, k
+    )
+    packed_scale = torch.stack(
+        (weight_scale[half:], weight_scale[:half]), dim=1
+    ).reshape(n)
+    return packed_weight.contiguous(), packed_scale.contiguous()
+
+
+def quantize_flux3_activation(x: torch.Tensor) -> QuantizedActivation:
+    """Dynamically quantize BF16 rows for one or more PrimsTS GEMMs."""
+    if x.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"FLUX.3 PrimsTS FP8 input must be BF16, got {x.dtype}")
+    x_2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]).contiguous()
+    x_fp8 = torch.empty_like(x_2d, dtype=torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+    x_scale = torch.empty(x_2d.shape[0], device=x.device, dtype=torch.float32)
+    per_token_quant_fp8(x_2d, x_fp8, x_scale)
+    return x_fp8, x_scale
+
+
+def _quantized_flux3_activation(
+    x: torch.Tensor, quantized: QuantizedActivation | None
+) -> QuantizedActivation:
+    if quantized is None:
+        return quantize_flux3_activation(x)
+    return quantized
+
+
+def flux3_fused_mlp_up(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    quantized: QuantizedActivation | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run fused FP8 GEMM + SwiGLU, quantizing BF16 rows when needed."""
+    if x.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"FLUX.3 fused MLP input must be BF16, got {x.dtype}")
+    x_fp8, x_scale = _quantized_flux3_activation(x, quantized)
+    out = prims_ts_gemm.fp8_linear_swiglu(
+        x_fp8,
+        packed_weight,
+        x_scale,
+        packed_weight_scale,
+        config=_flux3_gemm_config(
+            x, epilogue="swiglu", k=packed_weight.shape[1], n=packed_weight.shape[0]
+        ),
+        skip_check=True,
+    )
+    return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])
+
+
+def flux3_clustered_fp8_linear(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    quantized: QuantizedActivation | None = None,
+    qkv_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run a PrimsTS FP8 GEMM, optionally scaling packed Q/K/V thirds."""
+    if x.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"FLUX.3 PrimsTS FP8 input must be BF16, got {x.dtype}")
+    x_fp8, x_scale = _quantized_flux3_activation(x, quantized)
+    out = prims_ts_gemm.fp8_linear(
+        x_fp8,
+        packed_weight,
+        x_scale,
+        packed_weight_scale,
+        qkv_scale=qkv_scale,
+        config=_flux3_gemm_config(
+            x,
+            epilogue="linear",
+            k=packed_weight.shape[1],
+            n=packed_weight.shape[0],
+            qkv_scale=qkv_scale is not None,
+        ),
+        skip_check=True,
+    )
+    return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])
+
+
+def flux3_clustered_fp8_qkv_qknorm_rope(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    packed_weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    quantized: QuantizedActivation | None = None,
+    qkv_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    *,
+    separate_qkv_output: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fuse QKV GEMM, QK RMSNorm, and RoPE, quantizing rows when needed."""
+    if x.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"FLUX.3 fused QKV input must be BF16, got {x.dtype}")
+    x_fp8, x_scale = _quantized_flux3_activation(x, quantized)
+    config = _flux3_gemm_config(
+        x,
+        epilogue="qkv_qknorm_rope",
+        k=packed_weight.shape[1],
+        n=packed_weight.shape[0],
+        head_dim=q_norm_weight.numel(),
+        qkv_scale=qkv_scale is not None,
+    )
+    if separate_qkv_output:
+        if config is None:
+            major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(x.device)
+            config = prims_ts_gemm.PrimsTsGemmConfig(
+                arch=major * 10 + minor,
+                operand_format="fp8_e4m3",
+                output_format="bf16",
+                epilogue="qkv_qknorm_rope",
+                has_bias=False,
+                head_dim=q_norm_weight.numel(),
+                is_neox=False,
+                has_qkv_scale=qkv_scale is not None,
+            )
+        config = replace(
+            config,
+            separate_qkv_output=True,
+            use_tma_store=False,
+        )
+    out = prims_ts_gemm.fp8_qkv_qknorm_rope(
+        x_fp8,
+        packed_weight,
+        x_scale,
+        packed_weight_scale,
+        q_norm_weight,
+        k_norm_weight,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        positions,
+        num_q_heads=packed_weight.shape[0] // (3 * q_norm_weight.numel()),
+        num_kv_heads=packed_weight.shape[0] // (3 * k_norm_weight.numel()),
+        head_dim=q_norm_weight.numel(),
+        qkv_scale=qkv_scale,
+        config=config,
+        skip_check=True,
+    )
+    if separate_qkv_output:
+        return out.view(3, *x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1] // 3)
+    return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""FLUX.3 adapters for FlashInfer PrimsTS dense NVFP4 GEMMs.
+
+The dense PrimsTS kernels deliberately consume the canonical 128x4 block-scale
+layout.  Keep that layout as a flat buffer: reshaping it as conventional
+``[rows, K / 16]`` scales loses the swizzle required by the TMA descriptors.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import math
+from dataclasses import replace
+
+import torch
+from flashinfer import SfLayout, nvfp4_quantize
+from flashinfer.prims_ts import gemm as prims_ts_gemm
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.diffusion.gemm.flux3_prims_ts_config import (
+    flux3_prims_ts_config,
+)
+
+QuantizedNvfp4Activation = tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, float]
+PackedNvfp4Activation = tuple[torch.Tensor, torch.Tensor, float, tuple[int, ...]]
+_GLOBAL_SCALE_INV_CACHE: dict[tuple[str, int | None, float], torch.Tensor] = {}
+_PREPARED_FP4_CACHE: dict[tuple[object, ...], prims_ts_gemm.PreparedFp4Linear] = {}
+
+
+def _scale_numel(rows: int, k: int) -> int:
+    return ((rows + 127) // 128) * 128 * ((k // 16 + 3) // 4) * 4
+
+
+def _global_scale_inv(device: torch.device, input_global_scale: float) -> torch.Tensor:
+    key = (device.type, device.index, input_global_scale)
+    scale = _GLOBAL_SCALE_INV_CACHE.get(key)
+    if scale is None:
+        scale = torch.tensor(
+            [1.0 / input_global_scale], device=device, dtype=torch.float32
+        )
+        _GLOBAL_SCALE_INV_CACHE[key] = scale
+    return scale
+
+
+def quantize_flux3_nvfp4_activation(
+    x: torch.Tensor, input_global_scale: float
+) -> QuantizedNvfp4Activation:
+    """Quantize BF16 rows and return a canonical 128x4 E4M3 scale buffer.
+
+    ``nvfp4_quantize`` receives the reciprocal global scale, while PrimsTS
+    receives the dequantization scale.  Returning the exact 128x4 buffer is
+    essential: the dense kernel validates its padded element count and reads
+    it through 128-by-4 TMA tiles.
+    """
+    if x.dtype != torch.bfloat16:
+        raise TypeError(f"FLUX.3 PrimsTS NVFP4 input must be BF16, got {x.dtype}")
+    if input_global_scale <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"NVFP4 input global scale must be positive, got {input_global_scale}"
+        )
+    x_2d = x.reshape(-1, x.shape[-1]).contiguous()
+    if x_2d.shape[1] % 256:
+        raise ValueError(
+            f"FLUX.3 PrimsTS NVFP4 requires K divisible by 256, got {x_2d.shape[1]}"
+        )
+    packed, scale_128x4 = nvfp4_quantize(
+        x_2d,
+        # The CuTe-DSL quantizer takes the reciprocal global scale as a host
+        # float; a device tensor would cost four extra tensor ops per call.
+        1.0 / input_global_scale,
+        sfLayout=SfLayout.layout_128x4,
+        do_shuffle=False,
+        # The dense GEMM itself is CuTe-DSL.  Using the matching quantizer
+        # avoids FlashInfer's optional TRT-LLM quantizer extension and keeps
+        # the 128x4 layout native end-to-end on SM100+.
+        backend="cute-dsl",
+    )
+    scale_128x4 = scale_128x4.view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1).contiguous()
+    expected = _scale_numel(x_2d.shape[0], x_2d.shape[1])
+    if scale_128x4.numel() != expected:
+        raise RuntimeError(
+            "FlashInfer NVFP4 quantization did not return the required 128x4 "
+            f"scale buffer: expected {expected} bytes, got {scale_128x4.numel()}"
+        )
+    return packed.view(torch.uint8).contiguous(), scale_128x4, input_global_scale
+
+
+def _quantized_activation(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    quantized: QuantizedNvfp4Activation | None,
+) -> QuantizedNvfp4Activation:
+    if quantized is not None and quantized[2] == input_global_scale:
+        return quantized
+    return quantize_flux3_nvfp4_activation(x, input_global_scale)
+
+
+def _prepared_linear(
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+    config: prims_ts_gemm.PrimsTsGemmConfig | None,
+) -> prims_ts_gemm.PreparedFp4Linear | None:
+    # Caching would keep offloaded GPU weights alive; use the one-shot kernel.
+    if not weight_packed.is_cuda or getattr(
+        weight_packed, "_sglang_layerwise_offloaded", False
+    ):
+        return None
+    key = (
+        "linear",
+        weight_packed.data_ptr(),
+        weight_packed._version,
+        weight_scale_128x4.data_ptr(),
+        weight_scale_128x4._version,
+        input_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,
+        config,
+    )
+    prepared = _PREPARED_FP4_CACHE.get(key)
+    if prepared is None:
+        prepared = prims_ts_gemm.prepare_fp4_linear(
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            input_global_scale,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            config=config,
+        )
+        _PREPARED_FP4_CACHE[key] = prepared
+    return prepared
+
+
+def _prepared_swiglu(
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+    config: prims_ts_gemm.PrimsTsGemmConfig | None,
+    *,
+    fp4_output: bool,
+    device: torch.device,
+) -> prims_ts_gemm.PreparedFp4Linear | None:
+    # Caching would keep offloaded GPU weights alive; use the one-shot kernel.
+    if not weight_packed.is_cuda or getattr(
+        weight_packed, "_sglang_layerwise_offloaded", False
+    ):
+        return None
+    key = (
+        "swiglu_fp4" if fp4_output else "swiglu_bf16",
+        weight_packed.data_ptr(),
+        weight_packed._version,
+        weight_scale_128x4.data_ptr(),
+        weight_scale_128x4._version,
+        input_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,
+        config,
+    )
+    prepared = _PREPARED_FP4_CACHE.get(key)
+    if prepared is None:
+        prepared = prims_ts_gemm.prepare_fp4_linear_swiglu(
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            input_global_scale,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            out_dtype=torch.uint8 if fp4_output else torch.bfloat16,
+            output_quant_scale=(_global_scale_inv(device, 1.0) if fp4_output else None),
+            config=config,
+        )
+        _PREPARED_FP4_CACHE[key] = prepared
+    return prepared
+
+
+def _prepared_qkv(
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    config: prims_ts_gemm.PrimsTsGemmConfig | None,
+    qkv_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    *,
+    separate_qkv_output: bool = False,
+) -> prims_ts_gemm.PreparedFp4Linear | None:
+    # Caching would keep offloaded GPU weights alive; use the one-shot kernel.
+    if not weight_packed.is_cuda or getattr(
+        weight_packed, "_sglang_layerwise_offloaded", False
+    ):
+        return None
+    head_dim = q_norm_weight.numel()
+    if separate_qkv_output:
+        if config is None:
+            major, minor = torch.cuda.get_device_capability(weight_packed.device)
+            config = prims_ts_gemm.PrimsTsGemmConfig(
+                arch=major * 10 + minor,
+                operand_format="nvfp4_e2m1",
+                output_format="bf16",
+                epilogue="qkv_qknorm_rope",
+                has_bias=False,
+                head_dim=head_dim,
+                is_neox=False,
+                tile_k=256,
+                has_qkv_scale=qkv_scale is not None,
+            )
+        config = replace(
+            config,
+            separate_qkv_output=True,
+            use_tma_store=False,
+        )
+    key = (
+        "qkv_qknorm_rope",
+        weight_packed.data_ptr(),
+        weight_packed._version,
+        weight_scale_128x4.data_ptr(),
+        weight_scale_128x4._version,
+        q_norm_weight.data_ptr(),
+        q_norm_weight._version,
+        k_norm_weight.data_ptr(),
+        k_norm_weight._version,
+        input_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,
+        config,
+        None if qkv_scale is None else qkv_scale.data_ptr(),
+        None if qkv_scale is None else qkv_scale._version,
+    )
+    prepared = _PREPARED_FP4_CACHE.get(key)
+    if prepared is None:
+        num_heads = weight_packed.shape[0] // (3 * head_dim)
+        args = (
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            input_global_scale,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            q_norm_weight,
+            k_norm_weight,
+        )
+        kwargs = dict(
+            num_q_heads=num_heads,
+            num_kv_heads=num_heads,
+            head_dim=head_dim,
+            is_neox=False,
+            config=config,
+        )
+        if qkv_scale is not None:
+            kwargs["qkv_scale"] = qkv_scale
+        prepared = prims_ts_gemm.prepare_fp4_qkv_qknorm_rope(*args, **kwargs)
+        _PREPARED_FP4_CACHE[key] = prepared
+    return prepared
+
+
+def flux3_nvfp4_linear(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+    quantized: QuantizedNvfp4Activation | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run a FLUX.3 projection entirely through PrimsTS NVFP4 GEMM."""
+    a_packed, a_scale_128x4, _ = _quantized_activation(x, input_global_scale, quantized)
+    prepared = _prepared_linear(
+        weight_packed,
+        weight_scale_128x4,
+        input_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,
+        flux3_prims_ts_config(
+            x,
+            operand_format="nvfp4_e2m1",
+            epilogue="linear",
+            k=weight_packed.shape[1] * 2,
+            n=weight_packed.shape[0],
+        ),
+    )
+    if prepared is not None:
+        out = prepared(a_packed, a_scale_128x4)
+    else:
+        out = prims_ts_gemm.fp4_linear(
+            a_packed,
+            a_scale_128x4,
+            input_global_scale,
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            skip_check=True,
+        )
+    return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])
+
+
+def flux3_nvfp4_linear_from_packed_activation(
+    activation: PackedNvfp4Activation,
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run an NVFP4 projection without requantizing an intermediate result."""
+    a_packed, a_scale_128x4, a_global_scale, leading_shape = activation
+    prepared = _prepared_linear(
+        weight_packed,
+        weight_scale_128x4,
+        a_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,
+        flux3_prims_ts_config(
+            a_packed,
+            operand_format="nvfp4_e2m1",
+            epilogue="linear",
+            k=weight_packed.shape[1] * 2,
+            n=weight_packed.shape[0],
+            m=math.prod(leading_shape),
+        ),
+    )
+    if prepared is not None:
+        out = prepared(a_packed, a_scale_128x4)
+    else:
+        out = prims_ts_gemm.fp4_linear(
+            a_packed,
+            a_scale_128x4,
+            a_global_scale,
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            skip_check=True,
+        )
+    return out.view(*leading_shape, out.shape[-1])
+
+
+def flux3_nvfp4_linear_swiglu(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+    quantized: QuantizedNvfp4Activation | None = None,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run FLUX.3's gated MLP-up projection with PrimsTS' SwiGLU epilogue."""
+    a_packed, a_scale_128x4, _ = _quantized_activation(x, input_global_scale, quantized)
+    prepared = _prepared_swiglu(
+        weight_packed,
+        weight_scale_128x4,
+        input_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,

+def flux3_nvfp4_linear_swiglu_fp4(

+            epilogue="swiglu",
+            k=weight_packed.shape[1] * 2,
+            n=weight_packed.shape[0],
+            output_format="nvfp4_e2m1",
+        ),
+        fp4_output=True,
+        device=x.device,
+    )
+    if prepared is not None:

+            a_scale_128x4,
+            input_global_scale,
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            out_dtype=torch.uint8,
+            output_quant_scale=_global_scale_inv(x.device, 1.0),
+            skip_check=True,
+        )

+def flux3_nvfp4_qkv_qknorm_rope(
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_packed: torch.Tensor,
+    weight_scale_128x4: torch.Tensor,
+    input_global_scale: float,
+    weight_global_scale: float,
+    q_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    k_norm_weight: torch.Tensor,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    qkv_scale: torch.Tensor | None = None,
+    quantized: QuantizedNvfp4Activation | None = None,
+    *,
+    separate_qkv_output: bool = False,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Fuse NVFP4 QKV GEMM, Q/K RMSNorm, and RoPE through PrimsTS.
+
+    ``qkv_scale`` holds the per-partition Q/K/V weight scales already
+    multiplied by ``input_global_scale``; it must be a persistent tensor
+    because it keys the prepared-kernel cache.
+    """
+    a_packed, a_scale_128x4, _ = _quantized_activation(x, input_global_scale, quantized)
+    prepared = _prepared_qkv(
+        weight_packed,
+        weight_scale_128x4,
+        input_global_scale,
+        weight_global_scale,
+        q_norm_weight,
+        k_norm_weight,
+        flux3_prims_ts_config(
+            x,
+            operand_format="nvfp4_e2m1",
+            epilogue="qkv_qknorm_rope",
+            k=weight_packed.shape[1] * 2,
+            n=weight_packed.shape[0],
+            head_dim=q_norm_weight.numel(),
+            qkv_scale=qkv_scale is not None,
+        ),
+        qkv_scale,
+        separate_qkv_output=separate_qkv_output,
+    )
+    if prepared is not None:
+        out = prepared(
+            a_packed,
+            a_scale_128x4,
+            cos_sin=cos_sin_cache,
+            positions=positions,
+        )
+    elif separate_qkv_output:
+        raise RuntimeError("separate QKV output requires a prepared CUDA projection")
+    else:
+        head_dim = q_norm_weight.numel()
+        out = prims_ts_gemm.fp4_qkv_qknorm_rope(
+            a_packed,
+            a_scale_128x4,
+            input_global_scale,
+            weight_packed,
+            weight_scale_128x4,
+            weight_global_scale,
+            q_norm_weight,
+            k_norm_weight,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            positions,
+            num_q_heads=weight_packed.shape[0] // (3 * head_dim),
+            num_kv_heads=weight_packed.shape[0] // (3 * head_dim),
+            head_dim=head_dim,
+            is_neox=False,
+            qkv_scale=qkv_scale,
+            skip_check=True,
+        )
+    if separate_qkv_output:
+        return out.view(3, *x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1] // 3)
+    return out.view(*x.shape[:-1], out.shape[-1])

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import logging
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.jit.utils import cache_once, load_jit, make_cpp_args
+from sglang.srt.utils.custom_op import register_custom_op
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from tvm_ffi.module import Module
+
+
+_SUPPORTED_DTYPES = (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16, torch.float32)
+_BIT_EXACT_DTYPES = (torch.float16, torch.bfloat16)
+_FAILED_RUNTIME_KEYS: set[tuple[int | None, torch.dtype]] = set()
+# Below this the pass is launch-bound and the custom-op dispatch costs more
+# than the saved pass: on GB10 at 320x3072 bf16 the fused call is 15 us vs
+# 13 us eager, while at 27280x3072 it is 2.92 ms vs 4.52 ms.
+_MIN_FUSED_NUMEL = 4 << 20
+
+logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)
+
+
+@cache_once
+def _jit_residual_gate_add2_module(dtype: torch.dtype) -> Module:
+    if dtype not in _SUPPORTED_DTYPES:
+        raise RuntimeError(f"Unsupported residual_gate_add2 dtype: {dtype}")
+    args = make_cpp_args(dtype)
+    return load_jit(
+        "diffusion_residual_gate_add2",
+        *args,
+        cuda_files=["diffusion/residual_gate_add2.cuh"],
+        cuda_wrappers=[
+            (
+                "residual_gate_add2",
+                f"residual_gate_add2::ResidualGateAdd2Kernel<{args}>::run",
+            ),
+        ],
+    )
+
+
+def _fake_impl(
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    update_a: torch.Tensor,
+    update_b: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    return torch.empty_like(residual)
+
+
+@register_custom_op(
+    op_name="diffusion_residual_gate_add2",
+    mutates_args=[],
+    fake_impl=_fake_impl,
+)
+def _residual_gate_add2_custom_op(
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    update_a: torch.Tensor,
+    update_b: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    out = torch.empty_like(residual)
+    module = _jit_residual_gate_add2_module(residual.dtype)
+    broadcast_gate = gate.shape != residual.shape
+    module.residual_gate_add2(
+        out.view(-1),
+        residual.view(-1),
+        update_a.view(-1),
+        update_b.view(-1),
+        gate.view(-1),
+        residual.shape[-1],
+        broadcast_gate,
+    )
+    return out
+
+
+def _is_row_broadcast_gate(residual: torch.Tensor, gate: torch.Tensor) -> bool:
+    if gate.dim() != residual.dim() or gate.shape[-1] != residual.shape[-1]:
+        return False
+    return all(size == 1 for size in gate.shape[:-1])
+
+
+def can_use_residual_gate_add2_cuda(
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    update_a: torch.Tensor,
+    update_b: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+) -> bool:
+    tensors = (residual, update_a, update_b, gate)
+    return (
+        residual.numel() >= _MIN_FUSED_NUMEL
+        and all(t.dtype == residual.dtype for t in tensors)
+        and residual.dtype in _SUPPORTED_DTYPES
+        and all(t.is_cuda for t in tensors)
+        and all(t.device == residual.device for t in tensors)
+        and residual.dim() >= 2
+        and update_a.shape == residual.shape
+        and update_b.shape == residual.shape
+        and (gate.shape == residual.shape or _is_row_broadcast_gate(residual, gate))
+        and all(t.is_contiguous() for t in tensors)
+    )
+
+
+def residual_gate_add2_cuda(
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    update_a: torch.Tensor,
+    update_b: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    if not can_use_residual_gate_add2_cuda(residual, update_a, update_b, gate):
+        raise RuntimeError("unsupported input for residual_gate_add2 CUDA")
+    return _residual_gate_add2_custom_op(residual, update_a, update_b, gate)
+
+
+def residual_gate_add2(
+    residual: torch.Tensor,
+    update_a: torch.Tensor,
+    update_b: torch.Tensor,
+    gate: torch.Tensor,
+) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """``residual + gate * (update_a + update_b)`` in one pass.
+
+    Bit-identical to ``torch.addcmul(residual, gate, update_a + update_b)``: the
+    branch sum rounds to the tensor dtype and the gated product stays in fp32.
+    Falls back to eager on unsupported inputs or a JIT build failure, cached per
+    device and dtype like the single-update kernel.
+    """
+    runtime_key = (residual.device.index, residual.dtype)
+    if (
+        residual.dtype in _BIT_EXACT_DTYPES
+        and runtime_key not in _FAILED_RUNTIME_KEYS
+        and can_use_residual_gate_add2_cuda(residual, update_a, update_b, gate)
+    ):
+        try:
+            return residual_gate_add2_cuda(residual, update_a, update_b, gate)
+        except Exception as exc:
+            if torch.compiler.is_compiling():
+                raise
+            _FAILED_RUNTIME_KEYS.add(runtime_key)
+            logger.warning(
+                "Disabling diffusion residual-gate2 CUDA fast path on %s/%s: %s",
+                residual.device,
+                residual.dtype,
+                exc,
+            )
+    return torch.addcmul(residual, gate, update_a + update_b)
+
+
+__all__ = [
+    "can_use_residual_gate_add2_cuda",
+    "residual_gate_add2",
+    "residual_gate_add2_cuda",
+]

+"""Config for the FLUX.3 image VAE (the FLUX.2 packed image autoencoder,

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""Pipeline config and sampling params for image-only FLUX.3."""
+
+import json
+from dataclasses import dataclass, field
+from pathlib import Path
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models import DiTConfig, VAEConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.dits.flux3 import (
+    Flux3ArchConfig,
+    Flux3DiTConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.models.vaes.flux3_image import Flux3ImageVAEConfig
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.base import (
+    ModelTaskType,
+    PipelineConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.pipeline_configs.model_deployment_config import (
+    ModelDeploymentConfig,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.configs.sample.sampling_params import (
+    DataType,
+    SamplingParams,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.utils.argparse import StoreBoolean
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines.flux3_image_package import (
+        Flux3ImagePackage,
+    )
+
+_IMAGE_MODES = frozenset({"t2i", "i2i"})
+# Release repos: the distilled flow map and the CFG base model.
+FLUX3_IMAGE_HF_PATHS = [
+    "black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein",
+    "black-forest-labs/flux-3-image-klein-base",
+    "herzogenhorn/f3-image-small",
+]
+# Lower-case substrings of a Hub id or path that name a FLUX.3 image model.
+FLUX3_IMAGE_NAME_PATTERNS = ("flux-3-image", "flux.3-image", "flux3-image")
+
+
+def is_flux3_image_package(model_path: str) -> bool:
+    """Whether a local directory holds a FLUX.3 image package config, whatever
+    its name; the image DiT layout identifies it."""
+    try:
+        raw = json.loads((Path(model_path).expanduser() / "config.json").read_text())
+    except (OSError, ValueError):
+        return False
+    dit = raw.get("dit") if isinstance(raw, dict) else None
+    return (
+        isinstance(dit, dict)
+        and dit.get("out_modes") == ["image"]
+        and isinstance(dit.get("in_channels"), dict)
+        and "image_cond" in dit["in_channels"]
+    )
+
+
+def flux3_image_dit_config(**arch_overrides: Any) -> Flux3DiTConfig:
+    """The FLUX 3 DiT config with image streams (defaults: FLUX.3 Image Klein)."""
+    arch = {
+        "in_channels": {"image": 128, "image_cond": 128},
+        "sequence": {"x_image": "image", "x_image_cond": "image_cond"},
+        "out_modes": ["image"],
+        "vec_in_dim": None,
+        # Empty: the native DiT owns its packed-QKV checkpoint mapping.
+        "param_names_mapping": {},
+        # Adapter key prefixes: BFL/ostris ``dit.`` and diffusers ``transformer.``.
+        "lora_param_names_mapping": {r"^dit\.": "", r"^transformer\.": ""},
+        **arch_overrides,
+    }
+    return Flux3DiTConfig(arch_config=Flux3ArchConfig(**arch))
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Flux3ImageSamplingParams(SamplingParams):
+    """Request params for the image-only FLUX.3 pipeline."""
+
+    data_type: DataType = DataType.IMAGE
+    _default_height = 1024
+    _default_width = 1024
+
+    # The reference CFG pairs the prompt with an empty negative prompt.
+    negative_prompt: str = ""
+    guidance_scale: float | None = None
+    # ``None`` infers it per request: i2i with reference images, else t2i.
+    flux3_mode: str | None = None
+
+    @classmethod
+    def image_request_extra_fields(cls) -> frozenset[str]:
+        return frozenset({"flux3_mode"})
+
+    def prepare_synthetic_warmup_request_for_queue(
+        self, req: Any, server_args: Any
+    ) -> None:
+        # Warmup copies the request's steps as the full-workload target before
+        # any adjustment; ``None`` (server default) has to be resolved here.
+        for key in (
+            "warmup_target_num_inference_steps",
+            "cache_dit_num_inference_steps",
+        ):
+            if key in req.extra and req.extra[key] is None:
+                package = server_args.pipeline_config.flux3_package
+                req.extra[key] = package.config.sampler.steps
+        if self.flux3_mode != "i2i" or not req.image_path:
+            # TI2I permits references for i2i requests on the same server, but
+            # this synthetic warmup is unconditioned; with no reference (none
+            # is synthesized under breakable CUDA graphs) it warms the t2i path.
+            req.image_path = None
+            self.flux3_mode = "t2i"
+
+    def _adjust(self, server_args: Any) -> None:
+        package = server_args.pipeline_config.flux3_package
+        if (
+            self.guidance_scale is None
+            and package is not None
+            and not package.config.dit.flow_map
+        ):
+            self.guidance_scale = package.config.sampler.guidance
+        super()._adjust(server_args)
+        if package is None or not package.config.dit.flow_map:
+            return
+        # Reject CFG here so the API answers 400; the stages repeat these checks
+        # for direct pipeline calls.
+        scale = (
+            self.guidance_scale if self.true_cfg_scale is None else self.true_cfg_scale
+        )
+        if scale is not None and float(scale) != 1.0:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "the FLUX.3 flow-map (distilled) DiT samples without CFG; "
+                "drop guidance_scale"
+            )
+        if self.negative_prompt:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "the FLUX.3 flow-map (distilled) DiT samples without CFG; "
+                "drop negative_prompt"
+            )
+
+    def _validate(self) -> None:
+        super()._validate()
+        if self.flux3_mode is not None and self.flux3_mode not in _IMAGE_MODES:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"flux3_mode must be one of {sorted(_IMAGE_MODES)}, "
+                f"got {self.flux3_mode!r}"
+            )
+
+
+@dataclass
+class Flux3ImagePipelineConfig(PipelineConfig):
+    """Model-level config for the served FLUX.3 pipeline.
+
+    ``flux3_*`` fields default to the Klein package contract and are read
+    by the FLUX.3 text/denoise/decode stages."""
+
+    # One server serves text-to-image and image edits.
+    task_type: ModelTaskType = ModelTaskType.TI2I
+
+    # Standard model configs the framework reads during ServerArgs setup. The
+    # custom load_modules builds the real components; these keep generic tooling
+    # (task-type checks, vae scale factors) sane. The text encoder is the real
+    # Qwen3-VL embedder built directly in load_modules (not a diffusers text
+    # encoder), so text_encoder_configs is empty.
+    dit_config: DiTConfig = field(default_factory=flux3_image_dit_config)
+    vae_config: VAEConfig = field(default_factory=Flux3ImageVAEConfig)
+    text_encoder_configs: tuple = field(default_factory=tuple)
+    text_encoder_precisions: tuple = field(default_factory=tuple)
+    text_encoder_extra_args: list = field(default_factory=list)
+    preprocess_text_funcs: tuple = field(default_factory=tuple)
+    postprocess_text_funcs: tuple = field(default_factory=tuple)
+
+    # FLUX.3 loads and preprocesses its own conditioning image.
+    skip_input_image_preprocess: bool = True
+
+    dit_precision: str = "bf16"
+    vae_precision: str = "bf16"
+    vae_tiling: bool = False
+    vae_slicing: bool = False
+    vae_sp: bool = False
+    # FLUX.3 timestep embedding is not the diffusers embedded-CFG guidance path.
+    should_use_guidance: bool = False
+
+    # --- FLUX.3 generation knobs (read by the model-specific stages) ---
+    # Mode, steps and CFG scale are per request (references,
+    # num_inference_steps, guidance_scale) with the package's defaults.
+    # ``None`` takes the package sampler's value (see validate_server_args).
+    flux3_alpha: float | None = None
+    # The served package, resolved (and fetched from the Hub) once by
+    # validate_server_args; the loader builds the components from its local paths.
+    flux3_package: "Flux3ImagePackage | None" = field(default=None, repr=False)
+    # Dynamic compilation covers the package-defined variable token buckets.
+    # Reference-parity tests explicitly construct an eager encoder.
+    flux3_compile_text_encoder: bool = False
+    # Weight-only FP8 store; dequant on each encode. Default off.
+    flux3_text_encoder_fp8: bool = False
+    # Keep the visual VAE on GPU after a real request. Default off.
+    flux3_keep_visual_vae_resident: bool = False
+    # Keep DiT non-layer weights on GPU through VAE decode. Default off.
+    flux3_dit_keep_non_layer: bool = False
+    skip_empty_cache_after_request: bool = True
+
+    # Plain class attrs (NOT dataclass fields — no annotation).
+    _IMAGE_MODES = _IMAGE_MODES
+
+    def get_model_deployment_config(self) -> ModelDeploymentConfig:
+        return ModelDeploymentConfig(
+            # Allow automatic layerwise offload on memory-constrained GPUs.
+            dit_layerwise_offload_modes=("auto", "memory"),
+        )
+
+    def validate_server_args(self, server_args: Any) -> None:
+        """Resolve the served package once, adopt its sampler defaults and
+        reject CFG parallelism on a flow map."""
+        super().validate_server_args(server_args)
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.pipelines.flux3_image_package import (
+            resolve_flux3_image_package,
+        )
+
+        self.flux3_package = resolve_flux3_image_package(
+            server_args.model_path,
+            variant=server_args.model_variant,
+            revision=server_args.revision,
+        )
+        package = self.flux3_package.config
+        # A step-distilled flow map samples without CFG.
+        if package.dit.flow_map and server_args.enable_cfg_parallel:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "the FLUX.3 flow-map (distilled) DiT has no CFG branch to "
+                "parallelize; drop --enable-cfg-parallel"
+            )
+        if self.flux3_alpha is None:
+            self.flux3_alpha = package.sampler.alpha
+
+    def supports_dynamic_batching(self):
+        return True
+
+    def supports_native_grouped_requests(self):
+        return True
+
+    def supports_batching_image_conditioning(self):
+        return True
+
+    def served_modes(self) -> frozenset[str]:
+        """Image modes accepted by one FLUX.3 server."""
+        return self._IMAGE_MODES
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def add_pipeline_cli_args(parser):
+        """Register FLUX.3 generation flags. Invoked by the diffusion generate CLI
+        for ``--pipeline-class-name Flux3ImagePipeline`` (generic resolved-config hook).
+        All defaults are ``None`` so a flag only overrides the config default when
+        the user actually passes it (``update_config_from_args`` skips ``None``)."""
+
+        g = parser.add_argument_group("FLUX.3")
+        g.add_argument(
+            "--flux3-alpha",
+            dest="flux3_alpha",
+            type=float,
+            default=None,
+            help="Timestep-shift alpha.",
+        )
+        for flag, dest, help_text in (
+            (
+                "compile-text-encoder",
+                "flux3_compile_text_encoder",
+                "Compile the text encoder (default false).",
+            ),
+            (
+                "text-encoder-fp8",
+                "flux3_text_encoder_fp8",
+                "Store text-encoder weights as FP8 (default false).",
+            ),
+            (
+                "keep-visual-vae-resident",
+                "flux3_keep_visual_vae_resident",
+                "Retain the VAE between requests (default false).",
+            ),
+            (
+                "dit-keep-non-layer",
+                "flux3_dit_keep_non_layer",
+                "Retain non-layer DiT weights during decode (default false).",
+            ),
+            (
+                "skip-empty-cache-after-request",
+                "skip_empty_cache_after_request",
+                "Skip post-request empty_cache (default true).",
+            ),
+        ):
+            g.add_argument(
+                f"--flux3-{flag}",
+                dest=dest,
+                action=StoreBoolean,
+                default=None,
+                help=help_text,
+            )
+        return parser
+
+

+def add_resolved_pipeline_config_cli_args(parser: argparse.ArgumentParser) -> None:
+    """Let the selected or detected pipeline's config contribute extra CLI args.
+
+    The base ``PipelineConfig`` CLI args are registered before the model is known,
+    so model-specific fields (e.g. FLUX.3's ``--flux3-alpha``) can't be exposed the
+    normal way. This does a lightweight pre-parse for the explicit pipeline
+    selector (including its ``--pipeline`` alias), falling back to ``--config``
+    and then to the pipeline the registry detects for ``--model-path`` without
+    downloading it, and lets the selected config register its own flags. No-op
+    for pipelines that don't provide the hook (unchanged behavior for every
+    existing model)."""
+    pre = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
+    pre.add_argument(
+        "--pipeline",
+        "--pipeline-class-name",
+        dest="pipeline_class_name",
+        default=None,
+    )
+    pre.add_argument("--config", default=None)
+    pre.add_argument("--model-path", dest="model_path", default=None)
+    try:
+        known, _ = pre.parse_known_args()
+    except SystemExit:
+        return
+    pipeline_class_name = known.pipeline_class_name
+    model_path = known.model_path
+    if not pipeline_class_name and known.config:
+        try:
+            config_args = ServerArgs.load_config_file(known.config) or {}
+            pipeline_class_name = config_args.get(

+            ) or config_args.get("pipeline")
+            model_path = model_path or config_args.get("model_path")
+        except Exception as exc:

+            return
+    try:
+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.registry import (
+            get_non_diffusers_pipeline_name,
+            get_pipeline_config_classes,
+        )
+
+        if not pipeline_class_name and model_path:
+            pipeline_class_name = get_non_diffusers_pipeline_name(model_path)
+        if not pipeline_class_name:
+            return
+        classes = get_pipeline_config_classes(pipeline_class_name)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""FLUX.3 projection operators with PrimsTS and generic implementations.
+
+Each operator is a :class:`~sglang.kernels.fused_op.BaseFusedOp`.
+``forward_native`` is the generic SGLang path: the layer's own quant method
+plus SGLang's fused QK-norm/RoPE and SwiGLU kernels, on any device and format.
+``forward_flashinfer`` runs the FlashInfer PrimsTS epilogue that the layer's
+FLUX.3 quant method (:mod:`...quantization.flux3_prims_ts`) prepared at load
+time. FlashInfer is selected per call, only on SM10x and only for layers whose
+method planned the matching role, so call sites never branch on the backend.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.kernels.fused_op import BaseFusedOp, register_fused_op
+from sglang.kernels.spec import FormatSignature, KernelBackend
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.layernorm import apply_qk_norm_rope
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.flux3_prims_ts import (
+    FLUX3_PRIMS_TS_CAPABILITIES,
+    Flux3PrimsTsRole,
+)
+
+
+def _prims_ts_method(layer: nn.Module, role: Flux3PrimsTsRole):
+    """The layer's quant method if it planned ``role`` for PrimsTS, else None."""
+    method = getattr(layer, "quant_method", None)
+    if getattr(method, "prims_ts_role", None) is role:
+        return method
+    return None
+
+
+def _silu_and_mul(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    from sgl_kernel import silu_and_mul
+
+    d = x.shape[-1] // 2
+    out = torch.empty(x.shape[:-1] + (d,), dtype=x.dtype, device=x.device)
+    silu_and_mul(x.view(-1, 2 * d), out.view(-1, d))
+    return out
+
+
+def _unpack_qkv(qkv: torch.Tensor, local_heads: int):
+    """Return Q/K/V views from packed or separate-section GEMM output."""
+    if qkv.ndim == 4 and qkv.shape[0] == 3:
+        _, batch, seqlen, width = qkv.shape
+        return tuple(
+            tensor.view(batch, seqlen, local_heads, width // local_heads)
+            for tensor in qkv.unbind(0)
+        )
+    batch, seqlen, packed = qkv.shape
+    head_dim = packed // (3 * local_heads)
+    return qkv.view(batch, seqlen, 3, local_heads, head_dim).unbind(dim=2)
+
+
+class _Flux3PrimsTsOp(BaseFusedOp):
+    priority = (KernelBackend.FLASHINFER, KernelBackend.TORCH)
+    capabilities = {KernelBackend.FLASHINFER: FLUX3_PRIMS_TS_CAPABILITIES}
+    format_signature = FormatSignature(
+        supported_dtypes=("bfloat16",),
+        description="FLUX.3 projection; layer-prepared PrimsTS weights",
+    )
+
+    def _flashinfer_eligible(
+        self, layer: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor, role: Flux3PrimsTsRole
+    ) -> bool:
+        return (
+            x.is_cuda
+            and _prims_ts_method(layer, role) is not None
+            and super().backend_eligible(KernelBackend.FLASHINFER)
+        )
+
+
+class Flux3LinearOp(_Flux3PrimsTsOp):
+    """``layer(x)`` for an attention, MLP-down, or unfused QKV projection."""
+
+    op = "gemm.flux3_linear"
+    descriptions = {
+        KernelBackend.FLASHINFER: "PrimsTS FP8/NVFP4 dense GEMM.",
+        KernelBackend.TORCH: "Generic SGLang linear (layer quant method).",
+    }
+
+    def backend_eligible(self, backend, layer, x, quantized=None) -> bool:
+        if backend is KernelBackend.FLASHINFER:
+            return self._flashinfer_eligible(layer, x, Flux3PrimsTsRole.LINEAR)
+        return super().backend_eligible(backend)
+
+    def forward_native(self, layer, x, quantized=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # The generic method quantizes its own input; ``quantized`` is a
+        # PrimsTS operand and does not apply here.
+        out, _ = layer(x)
+        return out
+
+    def forward_flashinfer(self, layer, x, quantized=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        return layer.quant_method.apply_prims_ts_linear(layer, x, quantized)
+
+
+class Flux3QKVQKNormRopeOp(_Flux3PrimsTsOp):
+    """Packed QKV projection, Q/K RMSNorm, and RoPE -> ``(B, L, H, D)`` q, k, v."""
+
+    op = "gemm.flux3_qkv_qknorm_rope"
+    descriptions = {
+        KernelBackend.FLASHINFER: "PrimsTS QKV GEMM with QK-norm/RoPE epilogue.",
+        KernelBackend.TORCH: "FLUX.3 linear, then fused QK-norm/RoPE kernel.",
+    }
+
+    def backend_eligible(
+        self,
+        backend,
+        layer,
+        x,
+        norm,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        positions,
+        local_heads,
+        quantized=None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        if backend is KernelBackend.FLASHINFER:
+            return self._flashinfer_eligible(layer, x, Flux3PrimsTsRole.QKV_QKNORM_ROPE)
+        return super().backend_eligible(backend)
+
+    def forward_native(
+        self,
+        layer,
+        x,
+        norm,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        positions,
+        local_heads,
+        quantized=None,
+    ):
+        q, k, v = _unpack_qkv(flux3_linear(layer, x, quantized), local_heads)
+        q, k = apply_qk_norm_rope(
+            q,
+            k,
+            norm.query_norm,
+            norm.key_norm,
+            q.shape[-1],
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            is_neox=False,
+            positions=positions,
+            allow_strided_qk=True,
+        )
+        return q, k, v
+
+    def forward_flashinfer(
+        self,
+        layer,
+        x,
+        norm,
+        cos_sin_cache,
+        positions,
+        local_heads,
+        quantized=None,
+    ):
+        qkv = layer.quant_method.apply_prims_ts_qkv_qknorm_rope(
+            layer,
+            x,
+            norm.query_norm.weight,
+            norm.key_norm.weight,
+            cos_sin_cache,
+            positions,
+            quantized,
+        )
+        return _unpack_qkv(qkv, local_heads)
+
+
+class Flux3GatedMLPOp(_Flux3PrimsTsOp):
+    """``mlp_out(silu(gate) * value)`` with ``[gate | value] = mlp_in(x)``."""
+
+    op = "gemm.flux3_gated_mlp"
+    descriptions = {
+        KernelBackend.FLASHINFER: "PrimsTS MLP-up with SwiGLU epilogue.",
+        KernelBackend.TORCH: "Generic MLP-up, silu_and_mul, FLUX.3 linear.",
+    }
+
+    def backend_eligible(self, backend, mlp_in, mlp_out, x, quantized=None) -> bool:
+        if backend is KernelBackend.FLASHINFER:
+            return self._flashinfer_eligible(mlp_in, x, Flux3PrimsTsRole.SWIGLU)
+        return super().backend_eligible(backend)
+
+    def forward_native(self, mlp_in, mlp_out, x, quantized=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        mlp, _ = mlp_in(x)
+        return flux3_linear(mlp_out, _silu_and_mul(mlp))
+
+    def forward_flashinfer(self, mlp_in, mlp_out, x, quantized=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+        up = mlp_in.quant_method
+        down = _prims_ts_method(mlp_out, Flux3PrimsTsRole.LINEAR)
+        if (
+            down is not None
+            and up.packed_activation_format is not None
+            and down.packed_activation_format == up.packed_activation_format
+        ):
+            # Hand MLP-down the packed SwiGLU output without a BF16 round trip.
+            packed = up.apply_prims_ts_swiglu(mlp_in, x, quantized, packed_output=True)
+            return down.apply_prims_ts_linear_from_packed(mlp_out, packed)
+        return flux3_linear(mlp_out, up.apply_prims_ts_swiglu(mlp_in, x, quantized))
+
+
+_FLUX3_LINEAR = register_fused_op(Flux3LinearOp(), __name__, "_FLUX3_LINEAR")
+_FLUX3_QKV_QKNORM_ROPE = register_fused_op(
+    Flux3QKVQKNormRopeOp(), __name__, "_FLUX3_QKV_QKNORM_ROPE"
+)
+_FLUX3_GATED_MLP = register_fused_op(Flux3GatedMLPOp(), __name__, "_FLUX3_GATED_MLP")
+
+
+def flux3_linear(layer: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor, quantized=None) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Run one FLUX.3 projection; ``quantized`` is an optional shared operand."""
+    return _FLUX3_LINEAR(layer, x, quantized)
+
+
+def flux3_qkv_qknorm_rope(
+    layer: nn.Module,
+    x: torch.Tensor,
+    norm: nn.Module,
+    cos_sin_cache: torch.Tensor,
+    positions: torch.Tensor,
+    local_heads: int,
+    quantized=None,
+):
+    """Project packed QKV and apply Q/K RMSNorm plus interleaved RoPE."""
+    return _FLUX3_QKV_QKNORM_ROPE(
+        layer, x, norm, cos_sin_cache, positions, local_heads, quantized
+    )
+
+
+def flux3_gated_mlp(
+    mlp_in: nn.Module, mlp_out: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor, quantized=None

+    {CapabilityRequirement.cuda(min_sm=(10, 0), max_sm=(10, 9))}
+)
+

+class Flux3PrimsTsRole(str, Enum):
+    """PrimsTS epilogue planned for one FLUX.3 projection."""
+
+    LINEAR = "linear"
+    QKV_QKNORM_ROPE = "qkv_qknorm_rope"
+    SWIGLU = "swiglu"
+

+    """Whether this process may prepare FLUX.3 projections for PrimsTS."""
+    forced = get_fused_op_backend()
+    if forced is not None and forced is not KernelBackend.FLASHINFER:
+        return False
+    return capabilities_satisfied(FLUX3_PRIMS_TS_CAPABILITIES, PlatformInfo.detect())

+

+    """Whether TRT-LLM Gen Sage should receive directly separated Q/K/V."""
+    return envs.SGLANG_USE_SAGE_ATTENTION_IMPL.get().lower() in {
+        "trtllm_gen",

+    for leaf in (".q_proj", ".k_proj", ".v_proj"):
+        if name.endswith(leaf):
+            return name[: -len(leaf)] + ".to_qkv"
+    return name

+class Flux3PrimsTsConfigMixin:
+    """FLUX.3 deployment targets shared by both quantized formats."""
+
+    # Layer-prefix roots whose projections are PrimsTS deployment targets.
+    prims_ts_targets: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]]
+    # Additional roots where only packed QKV uses PrimsTS.
+    prims_ts_qkv_targets: ClassVar[tuple[str, ...]] = ()
+    head_dim: int | None = None
+    enable_prims_ts: bool = True
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_base_config(
+        cls,
+        base: Any,
+        *,
+        head_dim: int | None = None,
+        enable_prims_ts: bool = True,
+    ) -> Any:
+        """Specialize a generic checkpoint config for the native FLUX.3 DiT."""
+        config = cls.__new__(cls)
+        # Copy instance state rather than re-running ``__init__`` so values
+        # adjusted after construction (e.g. ``swap_weight_nibbles``) survive.
+        config.__dict__.update(vars(base))

+        config.enable_prims_ts = enable_prims_ts

+        """Hook for formats that must not silently fall back."""
+        return None

+    provide the format-specific eligibility checks and kernel calls.
+    """

+    activation_format: ClassVar[str]

+    packed_activation_format: ClassVar[str | None] = None

+            and self._prims_ts_layer_supported(layer)

+            and self._prims_ts_shape_supported(
+                input_size_per_partition, sum(output_partition_sizes)
+            )

+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def apply_prims_ts_linear(
+        self, layer: nn.Module, x: torch.Tensor, quantized=None
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        raise NotImplementedError
+

+        raise NotImplementedError(

+class Flux3RowwiseFp8Config(Flux3PrimsTsConfigMixin, RowwiseFp8Config):
+    """Rowwise FP8 for the native FLUX.3 DiT and its packed ``to_qkv``."""
+
+    prims_ts_targets = ("content_mode_blocks.image.", "single_blocks.")
+    prims_ts_qkv_targets = ("txt_mode_blocks.",)
+
+    @classmethod
+    def from_base_config(
+        cls,
+        base: RowwiseFp8Config,
+        *,
+        head_dim: int | None = None,

+        from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.linear import LinearBase

+        if isinstance(layer, LinearBase) and prefix in self.fp8_layers:
+            return Flux3Fp8LinearMethod(self)

+        input_size_per_partition: int,
+        output_partition_sizes: list[int],

+            # replaces, rather than duplicates, the checkpoint's [gate | value].

+        return flux3_clustered_fp8_linear(

+# ModelOpt NVFP4
+# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- #

+        denoiser. Unsupported hardware never plans PrimsTS, so it is exempt.

+            "%d QKV+QKNorm+RoPE, %d fused MLP-up, %d attention-out, and %d MLP-down GEMMs",
+            *([len(blocks)] * 5),

+    """Reorder ``[gate_0..H | value_0..H]`` rows as ``[value_i, gate_i]`` pairs.
+
+    PrimsTS' SwiGLU epilogue reads adjacent ``[value_i, gate_i]`` rows and
+    computes ``value_i * silu(gate_i)``. Packed rows and their per-row block
+    scales move together, before the scales are converted to 128x4.
+    """
+    n = weight.shape[0]
+    half = n // 2
+    weight = (
+        torch.stack((weight[half:], weight[:half]), dim=1)
+        .reshape(n, weight.shape[1])
+        .contiguous()
+    )
+    scales = (
+        torch.stack((scales[half:], scales[:half]), dim=1)
+        .reshape(n, scales.shape[1])
+        .contiguous()
+    )
+    return weight, scales
+

+"""Rowwise W8A8 FP8 quantization for diffusion linear layers."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.linear import (
+    UnquantizedLinearMethod,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.configs.base_config import (
+    QuantizationConfig,
+    QuantizeMethodBase,
+)
+from sglang.multimodal_gen.runtime.layers.quantization.fp8 import Fp8LinearMethod
+
+QUANT_META_KEY = "_quantization_metadata"
+FP8_FORMAT = "rowwise-float8_e4m3fn"
+BF16_FORMAT = "bf16"
+SUPPORTED_FORMAT_VERSIONS = frozenset({"1.1"})
+
+_ST_FP8 = "F8_E4M3"
+_ST_F32 = "F32"
+
+
+class RowwiseFp8Error(ValueError):
+    """Raised when a rowwise FP8 checkpoint violates its declared contract."""
+
+
+class RowwiseFp8Config(QuantizationConfig):
+    """Per-layer rowwise FP8 configuration read from safetensors metadata."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        *,
+        format_version: str,
+        fp8_layers: frozenset[str],
+        input_scale_layers: frozenset[str] = frozenset(),
+        num_linear_layers: int = 0,
+        num_bf16_layers: int = 0,
+        num_tensors: int = 0,
+    ) -> None:
+        super().__init__()
+        self.format_version = format_version
+        self.fp8_layers = fp8_layers
+        self.input_scale_layers = input_scale_layers
+        self.num_linear_layers = num_linear_layers

+"""FLUX.3 image DiT on SGLang's native diffusion framework.
+
+Builds on the FLUX 3 transformer in :mod:`.flux3` (shared with FLUX.3 Action):
+the stream / text embedders, timestep embedding, modulation layout, RoPE table
+and output heads are reused as they are. Only the blocks and the modulation
+projections are swapped for implementations that serve the image checkpoints:
+
+  * packed q/k/v -> :class:`MergedColumnParallelLinear` (``to_qkv``): one GEMM
+    then fused QK-norm+RoPE.

+    ``mlp_in`` separate is what lets the FP8 / NVFP4 PrimsTS epilogues own them.

+    sample boundaries through the selected backend's varlen implementation.
+  * fused LayerNorm modulation and residual-gate branch merge.

+@dataclass
+class Packed:
+    """Mode-major tokens with per-sample bounds for segmented attention.
+
+    A dataclass, not a msgspec.Struct: the breakable CUDA graph runner flattens
+    dataclass inputs into their tensor leaves.
+    """
+
+    data: dict[str, Tensor]
+    ids: dict[str, Tensor]
+    # Either one shared timestep or one per token, independently for each mode.
+    timesteps: dict[str, Tensor]
+    mode_indices: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int]]]
+    # Flow map only: the time each sample jumps to, ``(num_samples,)``. A tensor,
+    # not a float, so a captured CUDA graph reads the live value.
+    timesteps_ref: Tensor | None = None
+    # Request-owned positional tables; the ids do not change during denoising.
+    rope: dict[str, Tensor] | None = None
+    # Eager-only reuse of invariant text/reference mode-block outputs.
+    static_hidden: dict[str, Tensor] | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def num_samples(self) -> int:
+        return len(next(iter(self.mode_indices.values())))
+
+    def sample(self, index: int) -> Packed:
+        """Return one sample with mode-local bounds rebased to zero."""
+        return self.slice_samples(index, index + 1)
+
+    def slice_samples(self, first: int, stop: int) -> Packed:
+        if not 0 <= first < stop <= self.num_samples:
+            raise IndexError(f"packed sample range [{first}, {stop}) out of range")
+        data = {}
+        ids = {}
+        timesteps = {}
+        mode_indices = {}
+        rope = None if self.rope is None else {}
+        static_hidden = None if self.static_hidden is None else {}
+        for mode in self.data:
+            bounds = self.mode_indices[mode][first:stop]
+            start, end = bounds[0][0], bounds[-1][1]
+            data[mode] = self.data[mode][start:end]
+            ids[mode] = self.ids[mode][start:end]
+            time = self.timesteps[mode]
+            timesteps[mode] = time if time.numel() == 1 else time[start:end]
+            mode_indices[mode] = [(lo - start, hi - start) for lo, hi in bounds]
+            if rope is not None:
+                rope[mode] = self.rope[mode][start:end]
+            if static_hidden is not None and mode in self.static_hidden:
+                static_hidden[mode] = self.static_hidden[mode][start:end]
+        timesteps_ref = (
+            None if self.timesteps_ref is None else self.timesteps_ref[first:stop]
+        )
+        return Packed(

+def pack(
+    samples: list[dict[str, tuple[Tensor, Tensor] | None]],
+    channels: dict[str, int],
+) -> Packed:
+    modes = sorted(channels)
+    data = {mode: [] for mode in modes}
+    ids = {mode: [] for mode in modes}
+    mode_indices = {mode: [] for mode in modes}
+    counts = dict.fromkeys(modes, 0)
+    device = None
+    for sample in samples:
+        unknown = set(sample) - set(modes)
+        if unknown:
+            raise ValueError(
+                f"unknown packed modes {sorted(unknown)}; expected {modes}"
+            )
+        for mode in modes:
+            item = sample.get(mode)
+            start = counts[mode]
+            if item is not None:
+                data[mode].append(item[0])
+                ids[mode].append(item[1])
+                counts[mode] += item[0].shape[0]
+                device = device or item[0].device
+            mode_indices[mode].append((start, counts[mode]))
+
+    def cat(parts, width, dtype):
+        return (
+            torch.cat(parts)
+            if parts
+            else torch.zeros((0, width), device=device, dtype=dtype)
+        )
+
+    data = {mode: cat(data[mode], channels[mode], torch.bfloat16) for mode in modes}
+    ids = {mode: cat(ids[mode], 4, torch.float32) for mode in modes}
+    return Packed(
+        data=data,
+        ids=ids,
+        timesteps={
+            mode: torch.zeros(data[mode].shape[0], device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+            for mode in modes
+        },
+        mode_indices=mode_indices,
+    )
